title: UCP business profile
question: Does the merchant publish a Universal Commerce Protocol profile?
method: GET /.well-known/ucp. Pass on 200 application/json whose ucp object carries a version in YYYY-MM-DD form and services and payment_handlers objects (both may be empty). Warn when the profile is served after a redirect, as HTML content type, or without Cache-Control public with max-age of at least 60 seconds, all of which the specification forbids or requires. Fail when absent or not JSON. Shopify serves this profile for every eligible store; Google Merchant Center requires it for agentic checkout.

spec.title: Universal Commerce Protocol: overview and business profile

title: UCP checkout capability and payment handler
question: Does the UCP profile declare a checkout an agent could use?
method: From the profile: pass when a dev.ucp.shopping.checkout capability or a dev.ucp.shopping service with a rest, mcp or a2a transport is declared and at least one payment handler carries id, version and spec; warn when only one of the two is present; fail when neither. When a rest service names an endpoint, GET it and record the status: 404 or 5xx adds a warning, because the agent would fail there.

spec.title: Universal Commerce Protocol: overview and business profile

title: ACP discovery document
question: Does the merchant advertise an Agentic Commerce Protocol integration?
method: GET /.well-known/acp.json. Pass on JSON with protocol.name "acp", a protocol.version, an api_base_url and a transports array that includes rest. Fail when absent. The document is an unreleased proposal in the ACP repository, and checkout endpoints are otherwise registered with the platform privately, so this is the only public trace and the weight is low.

title: ACP feed fields
question: If the public feed follows the OpenAI format, does it carry the seller and return fields a checkout needs?
method: When B1.5 found a JSON, CSV or TSV feed with OpenAI-style columns, read sampled items. Pass when seller_name, return_policy and return_deadline_in_days (alias return_window) are present, or seller_privacy_policy and seller_tos (required for checkout) are; warn when only seller_name is; fail when none. Skip as not applicable for Google-format XML feeds, which have no such fields.

title: Guest checkout and cart API
question: Can an agent build a cart without an account?
method: GET /wp-json/wc/store/v1/cart must respond 200 with a cart object. Warn when the checkout page requires login (guest checkout disabled).

title: Shopify agentic storefront active
question: Is the Shopify store exposing its agent surface?
method: For Shopify stores: pass when responses carry Link: </.well-known/ucp>; rel="ucp" and GET /api/ucp/mcp answers as an MCP endpoint (405, 400 with a JSON-RPC error, or 200), which means the Agentic storefronts channel is active; warn when only one of the two answers; fail when neither does (the channel is off or the store is not eligible).
